message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Triage
on:
    pull_request:
        types:
            - "opened"
            - "reopened"
            - "synchronize"
            - "labeled"
            - "unlabeled"

concurrency:
    group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
    cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
    changelog_check:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        name: Check for changelog updates
        steps:
            - name: "Check if the source directory was changed"
              uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
              id: changes
              with:
                  filters: |
                      src:
                        - 'src/**'

            - name: "Check for changelog updates"
              if: steps.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
              uses: brettcannon/check-for-changed-files@v1
              with:
                  file-pattern: |
                      CHANGELOG.md
                  skip-label: "skip changelog"
                  failure-message: "Missing a CHANGELOG.md update; please add one or apply the ${skip-label} label to the pull request"

    tests_check:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        name: Check for updated tests
        steps:
            - name: "Check if the source directory was changed"
              uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
              id: changes
              with:
                  filters: |
                      src:
                        - 'src/**'

            - name: "Check for test updates"
              if: steps.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
              uses: brettcannon/check-for-changed-files@v1
              with:
                  file-pattern: |
                      tests/*
                  skip-label: "skip tests"
                  failure-message: "Missing unit tests; please add some or apply the ${skip-label} label to the pull request"

    all_green:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        name: PR has no missing information
        if: always()

        needs:
            - changelog_check
            - tests_check

        steps:
            - name: Check whether jobs passed
              uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
              with:
                  jobs: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
",
  "rationale": "Add concurrency control to cancel superseded runs for the same pull request. The workflow triggers on 'synchronize' (among other events), so multiple pushes to a PR queue multiple workflow runs. The P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE pattern (cancel superseded runs) estimates up to 4.1% paid VM time reduction by avoiding duplicate work. This change preserves all required checks and only cancels older runs for the same PR, with no impact on coverage or permissions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
